title: EVENTTHING Venue Library — sample-80-halls-20261027.csv
description: One record of `data/sample-80-halls-20261027.csv` (2,100 rows, 21 columns). Empty CSV cells are `null`; numbers are stored as CSV text and MUST be coerced before validation. Encoding: UTF-8 without BOM, LF. See `fields.md`.

venue_id.title: venue_id
venue_id.description: Hotel ID this hall belongs to (SHL-* / MAR-*); joins `sample-80-venues-20261027.csv`.

venue_name.title: venue_name
venue_name.description: Hotel name as recorded in the source.

room_id.title: room_id
room_id.description: Unique hall / meeting-space ID. Primary key.

room_name.title: room_name
room_name.description: Hall name as published (Chinese or English as in the source).

area_sqm.title: area_sqm
area_sqm.description: **Published area** of the hall in m². Usually the net exhibition area; for multi-storey halls, the sum of the floors. Blank when not published; never computed from length × width.

length_m.title: length_m
length_m.description: Length in metres of the hall's **building outline** (wall to wall), which includes walls, columns, plant rooms and circulation; blank when not published; never used to derive `area_sqm`.

width_m.title: width_m
width_m.description: Width in metres of the hall's **building outline**; same rule as `length_m`.

height_m.title: height_m
height_m.description: Ceiling height in metres; blank when not published.

capacity_max_pax.title: capacity_max_pax
capacity_max_pax.description: Maximum capacity where the source gives only one number without a layout; not additive with the four layout capacities.

source_url.title: source_url
source_url.description: Source page for this hotel's hall data; every row carries one.

data_level.title: data_level
data_level.description: `official` = parsed from the official site. Records flagged `suspect` are excluded from this sample.

dims_qa.title: dims_qa
dims_qa.description: Dimension QA note. Set when published area and length × width differ by more than 15%, so the two numbers are kept side by side. This is a caliber difference, not an error: the area is the published hall area (net exhibition area, or the sum of floors), while length × width is the building outline including walls, columns, plant rooms and circulation. Figures are never adjusted.

status.title: status
status.description: Status of the hotel the hall belongs to (`open` for every row in this sample). See “Status model”.

status_asof.title: status_asof
status_asof.description: Date of the status evidence, YYYY-MM-DD.
